text: I'd like you to make an animation of a white paper plane in a sunny study. I've had this little scene in my head for a while, and I'm curious to see it brought to life. It should be eight seconds long and widescreen, with no sound or text. Have the plane glide through the study for the first five seconds. Then it should land on a wooden desk during the last three seconds.
